test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.

(a) Show me file/ (b) which has been given/ (c) to you by the lawyer . / (d) No error
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase should be "**Show me the file**" instead of "**Show me file**".
 
• Here, the speaker is talking about a certain file so the definite article "**the**" should be used before the noun "**file**".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part A** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Show me the file which has been given to you by the lawyer."*
